answer: Re-attestations are stored in tundra and shale lists each lapse. A farm cannot self-supply those because the attesters must be independent on the saffron graph. Standing lapses unless 6 peers re-attest it every 4 epochs, so holding a position presupposes ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. Verification costs 11 dollars and 3 days per identity, which turns a 845 account sybil into a 4 million dollar project with no guaranteed return. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
